tellings.difference: This telling credits nobody, while the story's telling credits Paola Harris and Robert Oppenheimer; it also says only "UFO custody" from the 1940s on, without naming the Trinity craft or the year 1945.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Jacques Vallee's account of the custody chain from the Manhattan Project to the AEC to the DOE's own clearance system, in almost the same words. The "it" in the telling is the craft the story names as the Trinity craft.

as_told.title: UFO custody passed from Manhattan Project to AEC to Department of Energy clearance system

plain: A strange craft said to have been recovered in 1945, around the time of Trinity, the first atomic bomb test, would have been held first by the Manhattan Project, the wartime US effort that built the bomb, then by the Atomic Energy Commission that took over nuclear work after the war, and then by the Department of Energy, "which has its own line of clearances." The French computer scientist and longtime UFO researcher Jacques Vallée lays out this chain on two episodes of Michels' show; in one he links it to the researcher Paola Harris and the bomb's scientific leader J. Robert Oppenheimer, and in the other he speaks only of UFO material in general from the 1940s on. If true, it would mean such material sat inside the nuclear secrecy system, out of the military's ordinary view.
